name: Natural numbers
description: Positive integers, a(n) = n. The unit-gap base case.

name: Prime numbers
description: The increasing sequence of primes. Each jump is the next prime gap.

name: Composite numbers
description: Positive composite integers, beginning 4, 6, 8, 9, 10, …

name: Odd numbers
description: Positive odd integers, a(n) = 2n − 1. Constant jump d = 2.

name: Even numbers
description: Positive even integers, a(n) = 2n. The OEIS entry also includes 0.

name: Triangular numbers
description: Positive triangular numbers, a(n) = n(n + 1)/2. The OEIS entry also includes 0.

name: Square numbers
description: Positive squares, a(n) = n². The OEIS entry also includes 0.

name: Pentagonal numbers
description: Positive pentagonal numbers, a(n) = n(3n − 1)/2. The OEIS entry also includes 0.

name: Pronic numbers
description: Products of consecutive positive integers, a(n) = n(n + 1). The OEIS entry also includes 0.

name: Squarefree numbers
description: Positive integers divisible by no prime square, beginning 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, …

name: Primes ≡ 1 (mod 4)
description: Primes of the form 4m + 1. The jump goes to the next prime in this subsequence.

name: Primes ≡ 3 (mod 4)
description: Primes of the form 4m + 3. The jump goes to the next prime in this subsequence.

name: Not divisible by 3
description: Positive integers not divisible by 3: a(n) = floor((3n − 1)/2).

name: Triangle packing numbers
description: A(n,4,3). Strictly increasing tail from OEIS n = 4; the initial 0, 0, 1 prefix is omitted.

name: Binary-insertion sorting numbers
description: Worst-case binary-insertion comparison counts. Original OEIS indices retained; a(1) = 0 is unclassified.

name: Decimal palindromes
description: Base-10 palindromes in increasing order. Original OEIS indices retained, including a(1) = 0 in the unclassified count.

name: Floor-root divisibility numbers
description: Positive integers a for which floor(sqrt(a)) divides a.

name: Emirps
description: Primes whose decimal reversal is a different prime. Jumps go to the next emirp.

name: Odd exponent-bit parity
description: Integers whose prime-factor exponents have an odd total binary popcount.

name: Nonsquares
description: Positive integers that are not perfect squares.

name: Odious numbers
description: Nonnegative integers with odd binary popcount.

name: Floor of n to the 3/2
description: a(n) = floor(n^(3/2)), computed exactly as the integer square root of n³; n starts at 1.

name: Lower Wythoff sequence
description: a(n) = floor(nφ), with φ = (1 + √5)/2; evaluated using integer square roots.

name: Sums of three squares
description: Nonnegative integers representable as a sum of three integer squares, including 0.

name: Even exponent-bit parity
description: Positive integers whose prime-factor exponents have an even total binary popcount.

name: Squarefree composites and 1
description: 1 and the squarefree composite integers: products of at least two distinct primes.

name: Cumulative binary digit sum
description: Total binary popcount of 0 through n. Uses your site’s positive-index tail n ≥ 1; a(0) = 0 is omitted.

name: Prime powers
description: 1 and powers p^k of a prime p, with k ≥ 1.

name: At least three prime factors
description: Positive integers with at least three distinct prime divisors.

name: Sums of consecutive primes
description: a(n) = p(n) + p(n+1), the sum of consecutive primes.

name: Twin primes
description: Primes belonging to at least one twin-prime pair. Each prime is included once.

name: Semiprimes
description: Products of two primes, allowing equal primes.

name: Lesser twin primes
description: Primes p for which p + 2 is prime. Jumps go to the next lesser twin prime.

name: Sums of two squares
description: Nonnegative integers representable as a sum of two integer squares, including 0.

name: Primes and twice primes
description: The sorted union of primes and twice primes.

name: Beatty: 2 + √2
description: a(n) = floor(n(2 + √2)), evaluated using integer square roots.

name: Evil numbers
description: Nonnegative integers with even binary popcount, including 0.

name: Primes ≡ 1 (mod 6)
description: Primes congruent to 1 modulo 6. Jumps use consecutive terms of this subsequence.

name: Twin-prime centers / 6
description: Positive integers n for which 6n − 1 and 6n + 1 are both prime.

name: Decimal self numbers
description: Positive integers absent from the image m + decimal digit sum(m).

name: Loeschian numbers
description: Nonnegative integers of the form x² + xy + y², including 0.

name: Cyclic numbers
description: Positive integers a with gcd(a, φ(a)) = 1.

name: Integer divisor averages
description: Positive integers whose sum of divisors is divisible by their number of divisors.

name: Primes ≡ 5 or 7 (mod 8)
description: Primes congruent to 5 or 7 modulo 8.

name: Primes ≡ 2 or 3 (mod 5)
description: Primes congruent to 2 or 3 modulo 5.

name: Deficient numbers
description: Positive integers whose sum of all divisors is less than twice the integer.

name: Abundant numbers
description: Positive integers whose sum of all divisors exceeds twice the integer.

name: Harshad numbers
description: Positive integers divisible by their decimal digit sum.

name: Sophie Germain primes
description: Primes p for which 2p + 1 is also prime.

name: Safe primes
description: Primes p for which (p − 1)/2 is also prime.

name: Binary numbers without 111
description: Nonnegative integers whose binary expansion contains no three consecutive 1s, including 0.

name: Require four squares
description: Positive integers requiring four nonzero squares: precisely the numbers 4^r(8m + 7), with r, m ≥ 0.

name: Practical numbers
description: Positive integers for which every smaller positive integer is a sum of distinct divisors of the integer.

name: Primes minus one
description: a(n) = p(n) − 1, where p(n) is the n-th prime.

name: Prime-indexed primes
description: a(n) = p(p(n)): primes whose indices in the prime sequence are also prime. Jumps use this subsequence.

name: Greater twin primes
description: Primes p for which p − 2 is prime. Jumps go to the next greater twin prime.

name: Smith numbers
description: Composite integers whose decimal digit sum equals the sum of the digit sums of their prime factors, counted with multiplicity.

name: Binary palindromes
description: Nonnegative integers whose binary expansion reads the same forwards and backwards, including 0.

name: Isolated primes
description: Primes p for which neither p − 2 nor p + 2 is prime. Jumps go to the next isolated prime.

name: Happy numbers
description: Positive integers that eventually reach 1 under repeated replacement by the sum of the squares of their decimal digits.

name: Primes ≡ 5 (mod 6)
description: Primes of the form 6m − 1. Jumps use consecutive primes of this subsequence.

name: Take one, skip two
description: Keep 1 positive integer, skip 2, keep 3, skip 4, and continue with increasing block lengths.

name: Digit-sum orbit from 5
description: Start at 5; each next term is the current term plus its decimal digit sum.

name: Numbers containing an odd digit
description: Positive integers containing at least one odd decimal digit.

name: 11-rough numbers
description: 1 and positive integers not divisible by 2, 3, 5 or 7.

name: Primitive Pythagorean hypotenuses
description: Distinct hypotenuses of primitive integer right triangles, in increasing order. Equivalently, integers greater than 1 with every prime factor congruent to 1 modulo 4.

name: Numbers ≡ 0 or 1 (mod 5)
description: Nonnegative integers congruent to 0 or 1 modulo 5, including 0.

name: Primes plus one
description: a(n) = p(n) + 1, where p(n) is the n-th prime.

name: Binary self numbers
description: Positive integers not of the form m + the number of 1s in the binary expansion of m.

name: Distinct decimal digits
description: Nonnegative integers with no repeated decimal digit, including 0.

name: Base-4 self numbers
description: Positive integers not of the form m plus the sum of the base-4 digits of m.

name: Numbers containing 1
description: Positive integers containing at least one decimal digit 1.

name: Numbers containing 9
description: Positive integers containing at least one decimal digit 9.

name: Numbers containing 0
description: Nonnegative integers containing a decimal digit 0, including 0.

name: Cumulative distinct prime factors
description: Partial sums of ω(m), the number of distinct prime divisors of m, starting at m = 1 with a(1) = 0.

name: Odd nonprimes
description: Odd positive integers that are not prime, including 1.

name: Ternary palindromes
description: Nonnegative integers whose base-3 expansion is palindromic, including 0.

name: Odd digits only
description: Positive integers whose decimal digits all belong to 1, 3, 5, 7, 9.

name: Even digits only
description: Nonnegative integers whose decimal digits all belong to 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, including 0.

name: Twin-prime centers
description: Arithmetic means of twin-prime pairs, in increasing order. Each jump uses the next center.

name: 3-almost primes
description: Positive integers with exactly three prime factors, counted with multiplicity.

name: 4-almost primes
description: Positive integers with exactly four prime factors, counted with multiplicity.

name: 5-almost primes
description: Positive integers with exactly five prime factors, counted with multiplicity.

name: Prime plus its index
description: a(n) = p(n) + n, where p(n) is the n-th prime and n starts at 1.

name: Odd power-of-two residues
description: Positive integers m for which the least nonnegative residue of 2^m modulo m is odd.

name: Digit-sum orbit from 3
description: Start at 3; each next term is the current term plus its decimal digit sum.

name: Digit-sum orbit from 9
description: Start at 9; each next term is the current term plus its decimal digit sum.

name: Not two nonzero squares
description: Positive integers not representable as x² + y² with positive integers x and y.

name: Hoax numbers
description: Composite integers whose decimal digit sum equals the sum of the decimal digit sums of their distinct prime factors.

name: Square plus seven times a square
description: Nonnegative integers representable as x² + 7y² with integers x and y, including 0.

name: Sums of two triangular numbers
description: Nonnegative integers representable as T(x) + T(y), where T(j) = j(j+1)/2 and x, y are nonnegative.

name: Not two triangular numbers
description: Nonnegative integers not representable as a sum of two triangular numbers.

name: Not two squares
description: Nonnegative integers not representable as a sum of two integer squares.

name: Square plus cube
description: Nonnegative integers representable as x² + y³ with nonnegative integers x and y, including 0.

name: Prime factors of factorials
description: Total number of prime factors of n!, counted with multiplicity, starting at n = 1 with a(1) = 0.

name: Beatty: √5
description: a(n) = floor(n√5), for n ≥ 1; computed with an exact integer square root.

name: Divisor sum at least 3n
description: Positive integers m satisfying σ(m) ≥ 3m.

name: Lesser cousin primes
description: Primes p for which p + 4 is prime. Jumps use consecutive primes of this subsequence.

name: Lesser sexy primes
description: Primes p for which p + 6 is prime. Jumps use consecutive primes of this subsequence.

name: Beatty: √7
description: a(n) = floor(n√7), for n ≥ 1; computed with an exact integer square root.

name: Central polygonal numbers
description: Lazy caterer numbers, a(n) = n(n + 1)/2 + 1. Positive-index tail n ≥ 1; a(0) = 1 is omitted.

name: Hexagonal numbers
description: a(n) = n(2n − 1), n ≥ 1. The OEIS entry also includes a(0) = 0.

name: Centered square numbers
description: a(n) = 2n(n + 1) + 1. Positive-index tail n ≥ 1; a(0) = 1 is omitted.

name: Squares plus one
description: a(n) = n² + 1. Positive-index tail n ≥ 1; a(0) = 1 is omitted.

name: Quarter-squares
description: a(n) = floor(n²/4), strictly increasing tail n ≥ 2. Original OEIS indices retained; a(0) = a(1) = 0 are omitted.

name: Residues 2, 4, 8, 16 modulo 20
description: Positive integers congruent to 2, 4, 8 or 16 modulo 20.

name: Beatty: (1 + √3)/2
description: a(n) = floor(n(1 + √3)/2), computed exactly using integer square roots.

name: Beatty: 2 + √3
description: a(n) = floor(n(2 + √3)), computed exactly using integer square roots.

name: Take one, skip one, take two…
description: Take 1 integer, skip 1, take 2, skip 2, and so on, starting with the positive integers.

name: Skip one, take one, skip two…
description: Skip 1 integer, take 1, skip 2, take 2, and so on, starting with the positive integers.

name: Binary numbers without 000
description: Nonnegative integers whose binary expansion contains no 000, without leading zeroes; includes 0.

name: Binary numbers without 101
description: Nonnegative integers whose binary expansion contains no 101, without leading zeroes; includes 0.

name: Binary numbers without 110
description: Nonnegative integers whose binary expansion contains no 110, without leading zeroes; includes 0.

name: Binary numbers without 011
description: Nonnegative integers whose binary expansion contains no 011, without leading zeroes; includes 0.

name: Binary numbers without 001
description: Nonnegative integers whose binary expansion contains no 001, without leading zeroes; includes 0.

name: Binary numbers without 010
description: Nonnegative integers whose binary expansion contains no 010, without leading zeroes; includes 0.

name: Prime factors ≡ 1 (mod 3)
description: Positive integers whose prime divisors are all congruent to 1 modulo 3; includes 1.

name: Prime factors ≡ 1 (mod 4)
description: Positive integers whose prime divisors are all congruent to 1 modulo 4; includes 1.

name: Prime factors ≡ 3 (mod 4)
description: Positive integers whose prime divisors are all congruent to 3 modulo 4; includes 1.

name: Palindromes in base 4
description: Nonnegative integers whose base-4 expansion is palindromic, without leading zeroes; includes 0. Atlas indices start at 1, following the reference CSV.

name: Palindromes in base 5
description: Nonnegative integers whose base-5 expansion is palindromic, without leading zeroes; includes 0. Atlas indices start at 1, following the reference CSV.

name: Palindromes in base 6
description: Nonnegative integers whose base-6 expansion is palindromic, without leading zeroes; includes 0. Atlas indices start at 1, following the reference CSV.

name: Palindromes in base 7
description: Nonnegative integers whose base-7 expansion is palindromic, without leading zeroes; includes 0. Atlas indices start at 1, following the reference CSV.

name: Palindromes in base 8
description: Nonnegative integers whose base-8 expansion is palindromic, without leading zeroes; includes 0. Atlas indices start at 1, following the reference CSV.

name: Palindromes in base 9
description: Nonnegative integers whose base-9 expansion is palindromic, without leading zeroes; includes 0. Atlas indices start at 1, following the reference CSV.

name: Ternary numbers without 0
description: Positive integers whose base-3 expansion has only the digits 1 and 2. Atlas indices start at 1, following the reference CSV.

name: Base-4 numbers without 0
description: Positive integers whose base-4 expansion has only the digits 1, 2 and 3. Atlas indices start at 1, following the reference CSV.

name: Base-5 numbers without 3
description: Nonnegative integers whose base-5 expansion contains no digit 3; includes 0. Atlas indices start at 1, following the reference CSV.

name: Balanced binary digits
description: Positive integers with equally many zeroes and ones in binary, without leading zeroes. Atlas indices start at 1, following the reference CSV.

name: Equal digit sums in bases 2 and 3
description: Nonnegative integers whose binary and ternary digit sums are equal; includes 0. Atlas indices start at 1, following the reference CSV.

name: Equal digit sums in bases 2 and 10
description: Nonnegative integers whose binary and decimal digit sums are equal; includes 0. Atlas indices start at 1, following the reference CSV.

name: Balanced ones and twos in base 4
description: Nonnegative integers with equally many digits 1 and 2 in base 4; includes 0. Atlas indices start at 1, following the reference CSV.

name: Odious primes
description: Primes with an odd number of ones in their binary expansion. Atlas indices start at 1, following the reference CSV.

name: Evil primes
description: Primes with an even number of ones in their binary expansion. Atlas indices start at 1, following the reference CSV.

name: Prime decimal digital root
description: Positive integers whose decimal digital root is 2, 3, 5 or 7. Atlas indices start at 1, following the reference CSV.

name: Decimal nonpalindromes
description: Positive integers whose decimal expansion is not palindromic. Atlas indices start at 1, following the reference CSV.

name: Even binary parity above the last bit
description: Nonnegative integers for which the binary expansion, ignoring the least significant bit, contains an even number of ones; includes 0. Atlas indices start at 1, following the reference CSV.

name: Largest-digit orbit
description: Start at 1; obtain each successive term by adding the largest decimal digit of the current term. Atlas indices start at 1, following the reference CSV.

name: Exactly five binary ones
description: Positive integers whose binary expansion has exactly five ones. Atlas indices start at 1, following the reference CSV.
